cues.text: Three winged reptiles wait on a sunset cliff.
The blonde woman climbs aboard.
The boy mounts another.
She strokes its crest.
The reptile spreads its wings and launches from the cliff.
They glide above a winding canyon.
The boy grips his mount's crest.
Three winged reptiles soar toward the spires.
Townspeople gather along a street.
Inside, a crowd lines a red carpet. A bride and groom emerge.
The red-haired groom and blonde bride walk arm in arm, smiling at the crowd.
By a fire, the blonde woman in furs holds out her hand.
The young man presents a red-stoned ring.
She raises both fists and cheers.
In a red and gold hall, guards raise crossed swords.
A white-bearded, crowned man holds a sword.
The swordsman kneels, then stands.
The green-haired swordsman walks between the guards.
An armored man watches from behind a pillar.
He passes through the stone archway and walks toward the setting sun.
The bride closes her eyes as the couple kiss.
The bride rests her head on the groom's shoulder.
The crowd waves at the couple in the doorway.
The couple smile. Flowers, white doves and balloons rise into the sky.
In a forest, a bespectacled girl and a small robot run forward.
Green light shines over a baby in the grass. A blue pendant rests on its chest.
The girl smiles and lifts the bundled baby into her arms.
